content.text: {"summary":"Estimated c as the magnitude of ∂f/∂v near the origin, where only units 1, 2, 4, 6, 7 and 11 are active; it comes to about 0.42. Units 3 and 5 are one-sided v hinges for the quadratic drag. Several units mix q, v and u, so the slope varies by region and the estimate is approximate. Hidden unit 0 never activates on [-1,1]^3. I repurposed it as an always-on linear v unit with W1 row [0,1,0], bias 1 and output weight -0.42. I offset b2 by +0.42 so the net change is exactly -0.42*v.
